title: althaea micans
intro: Althaea micans, commonly known as the Marshmallow Plant, is a perennial herb native to Europe, Asia, and North Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and providing relief from respiratory problems such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Althaea micans include its demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to protect and soothe mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of the plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
